name: Business Process Technologies and Management
description:
The course focuses on advanced aspects of business process management and business process technologies. Starting from the process-oriented development of applications the following topics are discussed:
    • Management of resources and work lists
    • Logging and monitoring of business process instances
    • Introduction to process mining
    • Business process compliance
    • Runtime adaptations of business process instances and business process evolution
    • Modeling and correctness aspects of process choreographies
    • Modellierung und Korrektheitsaspekte von Prozessnetzwerken/Prozesschoreographien
prerequisites: Bachelor, IN0021 Introduction to Information Systems
